item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
What's New

  • First public release of Daily Battery: your day shown as a battery, draining block by block so you always see how much of it is left
  • Three ways to show it: a pill under the notch (Top Notch), in the menu bar, or a floating bar on your desktop
  • Plan your day with named, color-coded time blocks; overlapping blocks are caught before you save them
  • Built-in Pomodoro for each block, with a full-screen break reminder when it's time to rest
  • Double-click the battery to hide it for a while, and turn on Launch at Login so it's there every morning
  • Updates now arrive automatically, or check any time from Check for Updates… in the menu bar menu or the About window
  • Runs on macOS 14 Sonoma and later
